headline.purpose: Angular technical headings using Chakra Petch 500.

body.purpose: Japanese editorial character for reading and interface copy; Latin 400/700 assets are imported.

motion.name: popover-offset
motion.purpose: Short popover entrance; disabled for reduced motion.

materials.name: page-atmosphere
materials.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 600px at 0 0, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 11%, transparent), transparent 80%), radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 650px at 100% 8%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary) 10%, transparent), transparent 85%)
materials.purpose: Static pink/lavender atmosphere over the neutral page.

materials.name: public-header
materials.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(8px)
materials.purpose: Selective header translucency; opaque background and no blur with reduced transparency.

materials.name: section-rule
materials.purpose: Fine luminous boundary for release and upcoming sections.

materials.name: public-gutter
materials.purpose: Fluid public canvas, navigation and audio alignment.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The strongest task action with a static pink/lavender gradient.
components.css: .ds-primary{background:var(--primary);background-image:linear-gradient(115deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 92%,white),var(--primary) 55%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 75%,var(--secondary)));color:var(--on-primary);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;font:600 14px/1.4 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-primary:hover{background-color:var(--primary-hover)}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A supporting action on a lightly translucent raised surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--surface-raised) 86%,transparent);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 18px;font:600 14px/1.4 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background 160ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--surface-raised)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Text field
components.description: An explicitly labeled neutral form field.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:6px;color:var(--text);font:400 14px/1.65 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif}.ds-field input{background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 12px;font:inherit}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Active route with the shared frame-corner motif.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:6px;font:400 14px/1.65 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--text-muted);border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--text)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:7px;bottom:6px;width:7px;height:7px;border-right:2px solid var(--primary);border-bottom:2px solid var(--primary)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Status label
components.description: Status is named in text; its small dot is supporting information.

components.name: Unavailable poster
components.description: Stable artwork geometry with a truthful unavailable state.
components.html: Cover artwork unavailableAnime title
components.css: .ds-poster{display:block;max-width:160px;color:var(--text);text-decoration:none;font:600 14px/1.45 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif}.ds-cover{aspect-ratio:2/3;border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:12px;color:var(--text-muted)}.ds-cover small{font:400 12px/1.5 "Zen Kaku Gothic New",sans-serif;text-align:center}.ds-poster strong{display:block;margin-top:11px;min-height:2.9em;font-weight:600}.ds-poster:hover strong{text-decoration:underline}.ds-poster:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Sakuga wordmark
components.description: Typographic identity with one offset frame corner.
components.css: .ds-brand{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:0 10px 3px 0;color:var(--text);font:700 2rem/1 "Chakra Petch",sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;text-decoration:none}.ds-brand span{font-weight:500}.ds-brand i{position:absolute;width:12px;height:10px;right:0;bottom:0;border-right:2px solid var(--primary);border-bottom:2px solid var(--primary)}.ds-brand:hover{text-decoration:none}.ds-brand:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--secondary);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: Sakuga is a practical, independently voiced space for discovering anime and keeping a personal list. A broad black-and-charcoal canvas, Japanese editorial body typography and angular technical headings support real anime artwork. Pink/lavender atmosphere, luminous gradient rules and lightly translucent controls give the journal more expression without adding moving scenery. The typographic wordmark, one offset frame corner and concise language keep its identity coherent.
keyCharacteristics: Early source artwork and compact introductions.
Contrasting browsing and list compositions with quiet metadata.
A broad canvas, vibrant pink/lavender gradients and selective translucency.

rules.name: The Text Before Color Rule
rules.body: Status, source availability and errors remain understandable without color.

rules.name: The Still Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Gradients and translucency add color and depth; the page field never tracks the cursor or animates.

dos: Do keep search, real anime artwork and useful actions early.
Do use the broader canvas, static accent gradients and selective translucency with readable text and opaque fallbacks.
Do distinguish general catalog feeds from the signed-in user’s list.
Do preserve source provenance, selected-season behavior and existing preference fields.
Do use labels alongside color and keep secondary actions available to touch and keyboard.
donts: Don't invent creator profiles, favorites, recommendations, ratings or personal bylines.
Don't restore ripple, refraction, visual pointer loops, parallax, tilt, particles or background animation.
Don't use decorative Japanese text, mascots or a frame corner on every card.
Don't replace each route with the same panel dashboard or an oversized welcome hero.
